title: Chris's venues, his death, and closing questions
summary: Chris played at Economy Hall. He died fairly young after a short illness that Ben ties to dissipation. He kept the same string band with a clarinet, and the interviewers close.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: And Deer Rains on the other side. That's right. Can you remember other places that Chris played? You mentioned Economy Hall.
Yeah, where Griffin got church at that now, where Griffin got church?
Oh yes, that's the old Hopes Hall or Cooperators Hall. That's the Cooperated Hall. Was he sick long before he died? Do you remember when he died?
No, he didn't stay sick too long before he passed away.
What was his trouble? What did he die on from?
Well, he just died by dissipated little bit. He over dissipated something little bit.
Was he very old? Do you remember when he died? No, he wasn't really an old man when he died. I know he wouldn't be old. I mean, he was quite young then when he died. Sure.
Did he usually keep the same band all the time or did he have a different string band?
Well, right now all the time they had the same band.
And he had a clarinet in his band. Oh yeah? In the string band. Yeah.
